title: Bald Jemima Saves Christmas
overview: On Christmas Eve, Bald Jemima relishes in her detest for the holiday and her hatred for Santa. However, after she accidentally  gives Santa a crippling disease, she is forced to take on the burden of delivering presents. In this festive seasonal special, Bald Jemima must overcome her issues and reconnect with an old flame in order to save Christmas...
